criteria: blind re-implementation from a written spec reproduces every cell (tolerance 1e-6 rel.)

truncation: rebuild from data dated <= D, D's values identical

outcome reconciliation against an independent result table

v1 diff: only the four ppd columns may differ from the certified v1 dataset
